name: feishu-traework-local-auth
description: Optional local helper to reuse this machine's user-owned TraeWork Feishu authorization with official lark-cli environment credentials.

interface.shortDescription: Reuse your own TraeWork Feishu auth on this machine with lark-cli.
interface.longDescription: Optional advanced plugin for users who already completed Feishu authorization for TraeWork inside the Trae client on this computer. A local script reads the current user's Trae session, requests the short-lived Feishu user token already granted to TraeWork, and injects it through official lark-cli LARKSUITE_CLI_* environment credentials. Not the default Feishu Next auth path; prefer a self-owned Feishu app for durable multi-user setups.
defaultPrompt: Use $feishu-traework-local-auth:feishu-traework-local-auth to reuse this machine's TraeWork Feishu auth.
